assertion: Nearly one-third of the country's rural hospitals are at risk of closing due to financial strain.
independent_value: CHQPR: nearly 700 rural hospitals, one-third, at risk

assertion: its findings show 61% of Oklahoma's rural hospitals are at risk of closing.
warehouse_value: 36 of 51 OK rural hospitals lost money on patient services FY2025
independent_value: OKC Fox Aug 2026: 45 of 73 (62%); consistent with 44 of ~72 = 61%
sql: SELECT fiscal_year,count(*),sum(CASE WHEN net_income_from_patient_services<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM health.hospital_cost_report_financials WHERE state='OK' AND rural_urban='R' GROUP BY fiscal_year

assertion: including 44 just in Oklahoma. Of those 44, 17 are on the brink of shutting down.
measure: Oklahoma rural hospitals at risk of closing count
independent_value: Secondary coverage: 17 immediate, 44 at risk (States Newsroom summary); OKC Fox earlier edition 18 of 45. Not in primary PDF, which is national only.

assertion: Oklahoma Voice reports the assessment fails to consider supplemental Medicaid and tax payments, according to the head of the Oklahoma Hospital Association.
speaker: Oklahoma Hospital Association head
measure: Oklahoma Hospital Association supplemental Medicaid payments
independent_value: Search summary of States Newsroom Nov 12 piece: CEO said report does not reflect full financial picture and flagged supplemental payments (original 403)

assertion: Yet slow and below cost payments from healthcare plans do play a factor in the closures alongside Medicaid cuts.
independent_value: CHQPR PDF p.3 says private plan underpayment is the primary cause and Medicaid patients also lose money; statement is not wrong but understates the primary cause

independent_value: Sheps Center list: Claremore Indian (2025), Valley Community (2025), Mercy El Reno (2019), Latimer County (2018), Sayre (2018), Epic (2016), Memorial Hospital & Physician Group (2016) = 7
